title: The Very Secret Society of Irregular Witches
author: Sangu Mandanna
summary: Mika Moon is a young witch who keeps her magic hidden and posts only vague videos online. An invitation to teach three young witches at a remote house pulls her into a household and a grumpy librarian.
readIf: you want a warm, funny, low-stakes fantasy romance about finding a place where you belong.
skipIf: you want dark, high-stakes magic or a fast plot, since the story is gentle and relationship-driven.

pairings.reason: Another warm story where a lonely person finds a family among magical children.
A cozy, low-stakes fantasy about building a small, kind community.
A longer, more dramatic romance between a witch and an unlikely partner.
